stories.title: Report: Feds open investigation into Clippers' dealings with Kawhi
stories.summary: A federal investigation has been opened into the Clippers for allegedly circumventing the NBA's salary cap to compensate Kawhi Leonard, The New York Times reported.

stories.title: Sabalenka rolls past Pegula, will vie for three-peat in US Open final
stories.summary: Aryna Sabalenka defeated Jessica Pegula 7-5, 6-2 on Thursday night to advance to the US Open final, where she will chase a three-peat against new No. 1 Elena Rybakina on Saturday.

stories.title: Rams' Nacua acknowledges 'darkest times' of his life, battle with alcohol
stories.summary: Rams WR Puka Nacua told Netflix that "alcohol was definitely a thing" for him as he dealt with off-the-field stresses that included a rapid rise to NFL stardom and the birth of his son.

stories.title: No LSU sanctions after SEC expulsion meeting
stories.summary: A meeting of SEC presidents and chancellors Thursday ended without any punishment imposed on LSU.
